property.title: Boise Foothills Retreat
property.summary: A 5-bedroom foothills retreat with wide views and generous entertaining space.

content.title: Boise Foothills Retreat
content.lead: Wide views, big rooms and the foothills practically in the backyard.
paragraphs: Five bedrooms and four baths give everyone their own space, while the great room, formal dining room and outdoor living area handle the gatherings.
A home office, wine room and finished lower level round out a plan built for both work and weekends, with trail access close by.
